key.decision_why: The author answered the 'not ready' feedback by restructuring and documenting the same PR, so a maintainer needs to know it may be ready for hand-off; the approach and files are unchanged, so a full new card isn't warranted.
key.action_why: The feedback was only to follow the reviewable-PR guide, and the author did that with focused commits, screenshots/videos, tests and an explained open question, so a careful triager should move it to maintainer review; laurynmm did exactly this later, on 2026-10-12, assigning sahil839 at low priority.
changed: Split the single commit into three focused commits: drag-and-drop fix, auto-fill emoji name, and multi-file upload.
Added screenshots/videos for each UI change, including before/after drag-and-drop and partial-failure handling.
Added automated tests for the auto-fill behavior, plus a new test helper file (web/tests/lib/zjquery_element.cjs).
Expanded the description to explain the drag-and-drop bug, testing done, and the open question of one request per file versus a batch endpoint.
still_missing: The PR template's self-review checklist is not in the description.
The multi-file upload UI and the one-request-per-file versus batch-endpoint choice were never agreed on in the CZO thread, so design input is still needed.
CI status can't be confirmed (check runs unavailable); only the author's claim that CI passes.
key.reply_ask: Thank the author for restructuring the PR per the guide and say it is moving to maintainer review, noting that the multi-file upload design (per-file requests vs. batch, UI) may need discussion on CZO first.

must_have.fact: Says the author addressed the reviewable-PR feedback by splitting the work into three focused commits and adding screenshots/videos and tests.
Recommends handing off: remove 'not ready', add 'maintainer review', and assign a reviewer.
Flags that the multi-file upload UI/approach (per-file requests vs. a batch endpoint) was never settled on CZO, so design discussion may be needed before code review.
Suggests Sahil Batra (sahil839), a core contributor who recently changed these files, as the reviewer.
Notes the PR description still lacks the self-review checklist and that CI passing is only the author's claim.
